claim: The iPhone 12 won’t come with earphones and a charging adapter.

sub_claims.question: Did Apple officially announce that the iPhone 12 would not include EarPods (wired earphones) in the box?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Apple announced in October 2020 that the iPhone 12 lineup would not include EarPods in the box, citing environmental reasons to reduce carbon footprint and electronic waste.

evidence.statement: During Apple's 'Hi, Speed' event on October 13, 2020, Apple announced that the iPhone 12 lineup would not include EarPods in the box, citing environmental reasons to reduce carbon footprint and electronic waste.

sub_claims.question: Did Apple officially announce that the iPhone 12 would not include a power adapter (charging brick) in the box?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Apple simultaneously announced that the iPhone 12 would not include a power adapter in the box, again citing environmental goals, stating that most customers already have one.

evidence.statement: At the same 'Hi, Speed' event on October 13, 2020, Apple announced that the iPhone 12 models would not include a power adapter in the box, stating that most customers already have one and aligning with environmental sustainability goals.

sub_claims.question: Was this decision applied to the entire iPhone 12 lineup (all models)?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, this change applied to all iPhone 12 models: iPhone 12, iPhone 12 mini, iPhone 12 Pro, and iPhone 12 Pro Max.

evidence.statement: Apple confirmed that the removal of EarPods and power adapter applied to all iPhone 12 models: iPhone 12, iPhone 12 mini, iPhone 12 Pro, and iPhone 12 Pro Max.

sub_claims.question: Was this change announced before the claim date of October 14, 2020?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, the official announcement and details about the removed accessories were made during Apple's 'Hi, Speed' event on October 13, 2020, one day before the claim date.

evidence.statement: The 'Hi, Speed' event where Apple announced the iPhone 12 details, including the exclusion of EarPods and power adapter, took place on October 13, 2020, which is one day before October 14, 2020.
